and i enable faces mode amd then click a face[Image #21] 
then press delete button [Image #22] 
deleted whole face. ok now instead of doing face select lets just drag and select multiple faces to delete
so new model and u can see i have hit the face from selecting [Image #23] and lets press delete again [Image #24] 
notice what happened here. it deleted a triangle of the face and then also moved the selection to the other side

events.text: Two root causes: (1) mesh_edit.boxSelect face mode marked triangle centroids only — no authored-group expansion like click's setFaceGroup, so a marquee grabbed half a quad and delete cut a triangle; fixed by expanding centroid-hit tris to their full face groups after the rect pass. (2) meshDeleteSelection compacted the mesh with the selection tint still baked in the atlas (per-face saved patches keyed by current indices), so the post-replace restore painted orange onto whichever faces inherited the old indices; fixed by mesh_edit.clearSelection() before the rebuild — the same order detach/glass already use. Both Zig — needs rebuild to verify.
